paragraphs.source_en: Imai Sōkun shaded himself from the warm spring sun with his fan as he hurried toward Kōdai-in’s residence at Sanbongi. The realm had only just been pacified, and repairs to Fushimi Castle were nearly complete; it was said that Tokugawa Ieyasu, then in Osaka Castle, would soon move there. Sōkun had therefore gone ahead and built a residence at Fushimi Castle, and now scarcely ever returned to the port of Sakai.
